description: This file defines the CustomerAttributeService interface for managing customer attribute entities in the application. It declares methods for saving, updating, and retrieving customer attributes based on different criteria.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeService
classes.description: This interface extends the generic SalesManagerEntityService to manage CustomerAttribute entities and adds specific methods for saving, updating, and querying customer attributes.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerAttribute or updates an existing one, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute based on the MerchantStore, Customer ID, and attribute ID.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionValueId
methods.description: Returns a list of CustomerAttributes matching a specific store and attribute value ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Fetches CustomerAttributes filtered by store and attribute ID.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves all CustomerAttributes associated with a specific Customer in a given store.
